# Reunion Global — LLM Context & Agent Guide

> Reunion Global Private Ltd. is Coastal Karnataka's most trusted luxury hospitality brand, managing 17+ premium properties across Udupi district, Karnataka, India.

## About Reunion Global

Reunion Global Private Ltd. was founded in 2020 with a mission to redefine coastal tourism. We manage premium beach villas, oceanfront cafés, boutique hotels, and city villas — curated for families, couples, and groups who gather in style.

- [Website](https://www.reunionglobal.in): Primary portal for luxury stays and dining in Udupi.
- [About Us](https://www.reunionglobal.in/about): Company overview, executive team led by Mrs. Kshama Kadamba, and hospitality story.
- [All Stays & Residences](https://www.reunionglobal.in/properties): Complete listing of beach villas, city suites, and beachfront café.

## Property Portfolio

### Beach Villas & Coastal Stays

- [REUNION Ocean Elite](https://www.reunionglobal.in/properties/ocean-elite): Luxury 2BHK beach villa with direct beach access, private sea-view balcony, and spacious lawn in Hoode, Udupi.

- [REUNION Ocean Royal](https://www.reunionglobal.in/properties/ocean-royal): Heritage villa stay surrounded by coconut groves just 50 meters from the sea in Kapu, Udupi.
- [REUNION Ocean Daaffy](https://www.reunionglobal.in/properties/ocean-daaffy): Luxury beach villa located 100 meters from pristine shorelines in Uchila, Udupi.
- [REUNION Ocean Hridayam](https://www.reunionglobal.in/properties/ocean-hridayam): Beachfront 2BHK villa with split-level family layout and sea-view balcony in Mattu, Udupi.
- [REUNION Ocean Bliss](https://www.reunionglobal.in/properties/ocean-bliss): Peaceful 2BHK coastal villa with open compound near Malpe Beach, Udupi.
- [REUNION Ocean Waves](https://www.reunionglobal.in/properties/ocean-waves): Beachfront villa stay with 3 independent units just 5 meters from Mattu Beach, Udupi.

### Dining & Coastal Café

- [REUNION Ocean Café](https://www.reunionglobal.in/properties/ocean-cafe): Premier beachfront café at Mattu Beach serving continental, seafood, specialty coffee, and romantic candlelight dinners.

## Key Locations & Destinations

All properties are situated in Udupi district, Coastal Karnataka, India:

- **Hoode / Padutonse**: Direct beachfront villas with private beach access.
- **Uchila / Bada**: Peaceful coastal retreats and luxury pool villas.
- **Kapu**: Heritage beach area near the historic Kapu Lighthouse.
- **Mattu Beach**: Serene beachfront stays and beachfront dining.
- **Malpe**: Popular beach destination near Malpe Sea Walk and St. Mary's Island.
- **Udupi City / Chitpady / Kunjibettu**: Central stays near Sri Krishna Matha and city landmarks.
- **Manipal**: University campus town and healthcare center.
